versions.content: The ECU Manager module shall invoke the EcuM_Generat- eRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02919] ) callout before halting the microcontroller the EcuM_CheckRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02921] ) callout after the processor returns from halt. In case of applied multi core and existence of "slave" EcuM(s) this check should be executed on the "master" EcuM only. The "master" EcuM generates the hash out of all data that lie within its reach. Private data of "slave" EcuMs are out of scope.
